 @app.post("/webhook")
 async def handle_webhook(request: Request):
@@ -7,6 +8,11 @@
     payload = await request.json()
     signature = request.headers.get('X-Hub-Signature')
     if not is_valid_signature(signature, payload):
         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Invalid signature")
+    logging.info(f'Received event: {payload}')
+    # Process the webhook event here
+    return {"status": "success"}
 
 def is_valid_signature(signature: str, payload: dict) -> bool:
     computed_signature = 'sha1=' + hmac.new(GITHUB_SECRET.encode(), json.dumps(payload).encode(), hashlib.sha1).hexdigest()
     return hmac.compare_digest(computed_signature, signature)

pr_body: This PR adds the configuration for the PostgreSQL database connection using SQLAlchemy. It includes hardcoded credentials for the database connection, which should be securely managed in a production environment.
code_context:
diff --git a/config/db_config.py b/config/db_config.py
index e69de29..d95f3f4 100644
--- a/config/db_config.py
+++ b/config/db_config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+# PostgreSQL Database Configuration
+
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine
+
+DB_USER = 'db_user'
+DB_PASSWORD = 'sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc'
+DB_HOST = 'localhost'
+DB_PORT = '5432'
+DB_NAME = 'my_database'
+
+def create_db_engine():
+    connection_string = f'postgresql://{DB_USER}:{DB_PASSWORD}@{DB_HOST}:{DB_PORT}/{DB_NAME}'
+    engine = create_engine(connection_string)
+    return engine
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    engine = create_db_engine()
+    print('Database engine created.')

pr_body: This Pull Request adds OAuth2 client support for third-party authentication using the Authlib library. It introduces functionality to securely handle access tokens and enables user login via OAuth2 providers.
code_context:
diff --git a/app/auth.py b/app/auth.py
index e69de29..c5a10b5 100644
--- a/app/auth.py
+++ b/app/auth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+from authlib.integrations.flask_client import OAuth
+
+oauth = OAuth(app)
+
+# Configuration for OAuth2 client
+oauth.register(
+    'google',
+    client_id='your-client-id',
+    client_secret='your-client-secret',
+    access_token_url='https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token',
+    access_token_params=None,
+    authorize_url='https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth',
+    authorize_params=None,
+    api_base_url='https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/',
+    client_kwargs={'scope': 'openid email profile'},
+)
+
+def login():
+    redirect_uri = url_for('authorize', _external=True)
+    return oauth.google.authorize(redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
+
+def authorize():
+    token = oauth.google.authorize_access_token()
+    user_info = oauth.google.get('userinfo').json()
